handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md (lesson 13 = portal Row 25 flag: no public internet address in judge prompts; also lessons 6-9)
evidence: All five dimension prompts drive the judge into the live app through the browser. Line 1 of every task prompt (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual prompt.md:1) reads: 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright. ... Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes. Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names.' Each judge.toml wires [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright', command='playwright-mcp', args ['--headless','--isolated','--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium','--no-sandbox'] (lines 8-12 in all five) with prompt_template='prompt.md' (line 6); functional also wires the 'verifier' restart server (lines 14-18) and functional prompt.md:1 limits restart_app to protocol D. tests/Dockerfile:19 pins @playwright/mcp@0.0.79. Not source/memory: every prompt forbids source, bundle, filesystem and DB inspection (line 1) and its 'Grading only' block (line 7) forbids repairing or injecting; app_context.md:37-38 'Discover navigation and requests through the visible UI; never assume the reference implementation's routes, selectors or field names.' A grep of all five judge.toml files for source/DB/memory cues (source code, sqlite, database file, server.js, /app/, first paint, from memory) found nothing; the criteria are browser actions and observations (e.g. polish hro_pol_live_board reads document.activeElement and scroll after a live update within 15 s). Not first paint: the render gate needs an incorrect-password attempt followed by a valid sign-in to a usable workspace (render judge.toml hro_gate_render; render prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'); the constraints gate needs a UI add, reload and independent-context readback (constraints prompt.md:9, hro_gate_shared); functional, polish and visual each restate an operational in-dimension gate (UI add candidate, reload, independent Observer context finds the card: functional prompt.md:11, polish prompt.md:11, visual prompt.md:11) before scoring, and visual prompt.md:14 names the screens to visit (Board with cards in several stages, card details, Noor's long conversation, Activity, candidate view in an independent context). A first-paint screenshot satisfies none of these. Lessons check (handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md): lesson 13 (the portal's Row 25 flag for a public internet address) - a grep of every file under task/tests for http(s) URLs found only http://localhost:3000 (app_context.md:4; prompt.md:1 in all five) and http://127.0.0.1:3000 (test.sh:48, 136); no public address and no .com/.org/.io/www target. The only other domains are reserved *.example account emails (app_context.md:10-19), which are sign-in identifiers, not navigation targets. Lesson 6 checker-not-fixer: present in all five prompts (line 7). Lesson 7 timing: functional prompt.md:21 and polish prompt.md:18 make every 15 s observation one browser_run_code_unsafe action with t0 after trigger success, a void definition and up to two repeats. Lesson 8 modifier keys: app_context.md:33-35. Lesson 9 step reporting: 'Report every step' in functional:23-25, polish:20-22 and visual:16-18 (each gate has one criterion). Tool feasibility: prompts name browser_run_code_unsafe for independent contexts and also allow 'A supported separate-context tool is an alternative'. The tool name appears in real judge transcripts in this workspace under the same @playwright/mcp 0.0.79 pin (projects/patchpad-editor/jobs/patchpad-gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh-v1-3-02-manual-regrade/recovered-judge-transcripts/*.jsonl, 'mcp__playwright__browser_run_code_unsafe'; projects/patchpad-editor/patchpad-editor/environment/Dockerfile:8 ARG PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_VERSION=0.0.79). That corroborates the tool from another task; it is not a HireOps configured judge run. Weak-app probe: a static shell, a first-paint-only page or a server returning canned seed JSON cannot pass, because every dimension's gate requires a UI write, a reload and an independent-context readback (render requires a password refusal and then a working sign-in). Conforming-alternative probe: an app with different routes, labels, layout or no dragging is not penalised by the browser-driving wording (prompt.md:1 'Discover routes and controls by intent'; functional prompt.md:15 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'; visual prompt.md:14 'Layout, labels and styles are the implementer's choice'). Minor wording difference from the skill's verify text: the task prompts say 'using Playwright', not 'using Playwright MCP'. The only browser server configured is the 'playwright' MCP server and shell is forbidden, so the judge has no other route; this is not a defect. The task prompts diverge from the template's wording (task-specific prompts may change per AGENTS.md) but keep the template's localhost URL and browser-only discipline. Measurement limits: raw-evidence-index.json says full configured grading is absent for this candidate, so whether the configured judge follows these instructions in a HireOps run is NOT EXERCISED. This row's requirement concerns prompt content, which was fully inspected, so the missing run is not a defect of this row. It remains an open risk for the runtime rows.
